title: The Echoing Voice
text: A voice from below calls a Scion's name, rising out of a hole in the ground, in the Lost one's voice. It begs for help. It is almost right: the words are a little too careful, the pauses a little too long, as if someone is learning how to sound like them.

options.label: The steadiest mind answers the voice, and keeps it talking.

outcomes.text: It is a mimic, still learning. Still, it knows where they are, and says so to keep you talking a little longer.

options.label: Climb down to the voice. If there is any chance it is them, you must go.

outcomes.text: It is not them, and never was. It is very glad you came.

options.label: Roll a stone over the hole. Whatever is down there does not get to use their voice.

outcomes.text: Muffled beneath the stone, it keeps calling in their voice. You keep walking.
